<subject>Austream Solutions – Optimise Your Logistics IT Costs</subject>
<body>
Dear Darren,

Responsiveness, scalability, and continuous operational support are the cornerstones of Austream Solutions. Our agile hybrid on-site/offshore 24/7 delivery model covers a full range of outsourcing services – from fleet management systems maintenance and custom development, to infrastructure modernisation and complete technology outsourcing, including data centre operations.

We can offer Tasman Ridge Resources our Certified AWS and Oracle professionals at A$28/hr to support your projects. We employ nearly 500 specialists and operate state-of-the-art development facilities. Our Global Technology Centers in Bangalore are recognised as the "crown jewel" of Austream and represent a genuine competitive advantage for you.

https://www.austreamtech.com.au/

Over the past decade, our Global Technology Centers (GTCs) in Bangalore have delivered an outstanding track record of project successes for our Australian, European, and Asian customers.

Our Innovation Centers (IC's) and GTC's deliver the following capabilities to our clients:

   a.. Advanced Mine Planning Software Integration
   b.. Rail & Port Systems Architecture and Jay Moran
   c.. Legacy System Re-engineering Services
   d.. Cross-Platform Porting Services
   e.. 24/7 Help Desk / Technical Support Services

While all our services can be executed from one of our onshore facilities, our customers derive substantial value from leveraging our offshore delivery capabilities. Please visit https://www.austreamtech.com.au/

This 24/7 development and delivery model enables Austream to rapidly scale project teams to meet your requirements, to pursue parallel workstreams and to maximise productivity across a genuine virtual 24-hour work cycle on your projects.

Darren, please let us know if we can arrange a brief meeting to discuss these details. Look forward to hearing from you soon.
